newsitem.title: FRANCE: Eurotunnel chairman has 19.32 pct of votes.
newsitem.headline: Eurotunnel chairman has 19.32 pct of votes.

text.p: Eurotunnel SA / Plc said on Thursday its chairman had received mandates for 19.32 percent of the votes of the company's share capital while 29.62 percent of votes were represented at a meeting on a debt deal.

Christian Cambier of the Eurotunnel shareholders' association, who has said he would vote Yes, represents 2.05 percent of the capital. Sophie l'Helias and FGIS, who will also vote in favour, have 0.80 percent.
The statement said that Albert Jauffret of shareholder group Adacte, who said he would vote against the deal, had not signed the acceptances for the mandates given to him.
The company added that 1,748 shareholders, holding 3.84 percent of the capital, were physically present at the meeting.
There are 9,199 votes by mail, representing 3.53 percent of the capital.
